messages:
lena_sales: AstraCare POC asking for SOC 2 Type II PDF, ISO27001 scope excerpt, and a signed pen-test attestation. They want the onboard bundle + a short note on hosted vs private VPC latency/cost for ~200 RPS. Need by COB tomorrow. Any quick blockers?
omar_pre_sales: Short answer: we can share SOC2.pdf + iso_scope.pdf + pentest_attestation.pdf. Full pentest report requires NDA + redaction. Do they want the control mapping CSV too? That helps their GRC team.
rachael_sec: We can produce attestation today. Full pentest: requires mutual NDA and vendor consent — that adds ~48h. Also: we should not accept raw PHI or secrets in uploads. If they want to send traces, use presigned S3 with a 7-day expiry and a redaction checklist.
tim_fin: Pricing shorthand: hosted (multi-tenant) is lower unit cost; private VPC (dedicated pool) is ~30% higher in committed monthly run-rate for the same sustained throughput. For a POC offer: 10-day reserved trial, 1M tokens cap, staging IPs, and 4 support-hours included. I'll drop numbers into a one-pager.
lena_sales: They also want to upload a 1.5GB trace. Can we provide an upload path and example command?
omar_pre_sales: Yes — example: 
```bash
# upload path: evidence_uploads/astra/POC_2026-04-01/trace.zip
curl -X PUT -T trace.zip "${PRESIGNED_URL}"
```
Please instruct them to sanitize. Redaction checklist: remove PII, mask PHI, remove API keys/authorization tokens, and strip stack traces containing prod hostnames.
rachael_sec: +1 on redaction. Also note: do NOT include private keys, KMS plaintext, or full user SSNs. If they insist on sending sensitive items, we need an isolated transfer and a signed DSA.
ops-bot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-7782 (AstraCare POC). Owner: omar_pre_sales.
lena_sales: Can someone assemble a single zip for delivery: SOC2.pdf, iso_scope.pdf, control_mapping.csv, pentest_attestation.pdf, poc_pricing_sheet.pdf, and key_docs_readme.txt? I'll send that bundle to their CISO.
tim_fin: I'll prepare poc_pricing_sheet.pdf with two lines: Hosted (on-demand) 9-- per-token + per-rps guidance; Private VPC (reserved) 9-- monthly reserve + burst pricing. Include note: trial 10 days, 1M tokens cap, dedicated latency p95 ~40-60ms vs hosted p95 ~120-160ms at 200 RPS. ETA: 5pm PT.
omar_pre_sales: Once I have the presigned URL I'll post it here and attach the minimal redaction guide for the customer.
rachael_sec: Attestation signed by security lead ready to go. If legal needs to redact anything for distribution, ping @tim_fin and I'll hold the file.
lena_sales: Great — I'll package and reply to AstraCare. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
